newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends steady at 35.63/64 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends steady at 35.63/64 per dollar.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.63/64 per dollar on Thursday, nearly unchanged from the opening levels, dealers said.
Dealers reported moderate demand for dollars in the morning session. The day's quotes ranged between 35.6350 and 35.6450.
"The market is driven more by sentiments these days," said a bank dealer. Usually daily demand and supply determines the exchange rate, dealers said.
"People are expecting GDR funds," a dealer said, referring to funds raised by a leading bank through an issue of global depositary receipts (GDR).
Importers were keeping away on widespread expectations of easing of domestic liquidity by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Easing liquidity would soften premia on forward dollars.
Commercial banks and securities firms are looking forward to a cut in cash reserve ratio for banks in its credit policy announcement expected later this month.
Premia on forward dollars edged up towards close as some financial institutions were paying, some dealers said.
